description: Lists bus and coach types available for chartered group transport with a driver in and from Tokyo (charter coaches and minibuses), the 7-seat private car with driver (alphard-7, max 6 passengers, hire-car licence, arranged with licensed local hire-car operators per request, requests accepted across Japan) and add-on cars offered only with a coach booking. Returns passenger seats (driver excluded), auxiliary seats, luggage information and verification status. Optionally recommends a bus combination for a passenger and suitcase count. Also returns fixed_prices: the website's fixed package prices per vehicle (JPY, tax included) for 2 h in Tokyo, Haneda/Narita transfers and Hakone/Fuji/Nikko day trips, plus the 7-seat Alphard day rate — quote these exactly.

allow_auxiliary_seats.description: false = do not count fold-down auxiliary seats.

carry_on_bags.description: Carry-on bags kept in the cabin.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for names and messages: en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW, ko, th, id, fr, de, es or it. Defaults to en.

passengers.description: Number of passengers, to get a recommended combination.
